title: I made a narrative game using AI for player interactions and visual assets
author: lsocha
selftext:
Hi! I’m the solo developer of **Witek Adventures**, a free narrative game about a wheelchair user dealing with everyday barriers.

In selected situations, players can type what Witek should say or attempt. AI interprets their words within the current scene, while the game’s rules keep the consequences consistent.

AI was also used to generate and iterate on some of the game’s visual assets, which I selected, edited and integrated into the finished levels.

The game contains five story levels, supports English and Polish, and has no ads or in-app purchases.

I’d be interested to hear how other developers combine AI-generated assets with interactive AI features.

Browser: [https://witekadventures.com/](https://witekadventures.com/)  
Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.witekadventures.app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.witekadventures.app)

comments.author: HappyClamOfficial
comments.body: I like the idea. I often come across vehicles that are parked with their tail gaits hanging over the sidewalk, which makes using the sidewalk impossible for wheelchair users. Cool idea!

replies.author: lsocha
replies.body: I tried to show real situations with a few easter eggs to keep humour :)
